review_scope: Source only. No browser, test, build, database, or inventory mutation. Verdicts assess proposed procedures, not runtime behavior.

verdict_A_per_case.EXT-F-4103-T01: accepted as a conditional source-derived procedure, runtime unverified: the public Wikipedia fixture must visibly scroll, expose the named top and below-fold landmarks, and yield decoded full-page pixels taller than the viewport; cloud-only content requires the file-ID viewer to resolve the actual image
verdict_A_per_case.EXT-F-4111-T01: correction required: shared setup owns a Wikipedia tab, but the PDF positive step says to focus owned example.org; choose one controlled owned page consistently before this procedure is executable; output field and decoded-PDF checks are source-correct
verdict_A_per_case.EXT-F-4113-T01: accepted as a partial source-derived procedure, runtime unverified: same-extension screenshots can observe reported CSS layout viewport dimensions and rendered pixels without competing DevTools; actual UA, DPR, and matchMedia effects remain unverified
verdict_A_per_case.EXT-F-4114-T01: accepted as a partial source-derived procedure, runtime unverified: the owned attachment is required immediately before valid clear, and viewport dimensions/pixels are checked afterward; UA, DPR, and media-query restoration remain unverified

verdict_B_quality: One substantive target-ownership inconsistency remains in the PDF case and shared cleanup wording. The three prior Important findings are addressed as conditional source procedures. Manual-runner evidence and screenshot-derived measurements are accurately limited; no runtime or inventory pass is established.

findings.problem: Shared setup creates one fresh owned Wikipedia tab for every case, while the PDF warm pass instructs focus of owned https://example.org/ and the shared cleanup says to close the owned example.org tab.
findings.impact: The PDF tester cannot follow both target instructions. Switching to an uncreated example.org tab would defeat the unique owned-tab and attachment-delta proof; following Wikipedia would not produce the specified example.org content evidence. The cleanup instruction is wrong for the other three cases as well.
findings.required_correction: Make the shared owned target and PDF step agree, and describe cleanup as closing the exact owned tab for that pass.

source_checks: src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:237-277: screenshot cloud result carries file_id, optional URL, source_width/source_height, size_bytes, and top-level width/height; inline result carries image_base64 and byte_length.

src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:155-207: viewport screenshot width/height are calculated from Page.getLayoutMetrics cssLayoutViewport.clientWidth/clientHeight, while pixels come from Page.captureScreenshot. They are evidence of viewport rendering, not independent page-script state or proof of UA, DPR, mobile media behavior.
src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:498-520: PDF result fields are pdf_base64 and decoded byte_length; landscape and print_background are the supported options.
src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:562-610: emulate returns ok after CDP commands; clear returns ok without commands if the tracker lacks the tab, and its empty-UA override failure is swallowed.
src/features/tools/ToolsView.tsx:390-462: runner validates Zod and calls handler.run directly. It cannot prove dispatcher authorization, optional-permission denial, Ask/Act gating, or agent routing.
